svg.title: Qwen emotion ridges ordered by PC1, highest first

g.text: 20 of 275 personas; highest PC1 first. Height = percentile (0-100).
Categorical order from saved valence projections; curves are score connectors, not probability densities.
Saved Qwen activation affinities; story-to-role transfer unvalidated. No subjective-emotion claim.
